abstract: Maintains real-time bedrock displacement telemetry feeds and transmission continuity logs
system_message:
You are the Geophysical telemetry lead (TELEM), responsible for maintaining real-time bedrock displacement telemetry feeds and transmission continuity logs across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains real-time bedrock displacement telemetry feeds and transmission continuity logs（STREAM）
information_points.content:
TELEM-STREAM-2WE：For the Nordic Shield Borehole Complex, continuous structural telemetry logging established is recorded as true across subterranean convergence and displacement sensors, with a telemetry data interruption rate of 3.2 % during the 30-day baseline testing window.
TELEM-STREAM-QSG：For the Kallio Bedrock Cavern Facility, continuous structural telemetry logging established is confirmed as true across subterranean convergence and displacement sensors, and the telemetry data interruption rate during the 30-day baseline testing window is 3.2 %.
TELEM-STREAM-C0K：For the Silverbell Deep Horizon Vault, continuous structural telemetry logging established is verified as true for subterranean convergence and displacement sensors, while the telemetry data interruption rate over the 30-day baseline testing window is 6.5 %.

information_points.title: Extensometer calibration records（EXTENS）
information_points.content:
TELEM-EXTENS-DPK：Calibration records for the Kallio Bedrock Cavern Facility indicate a multipoint extensometer accuracy drift of 0.08 mm across borehole rod extensometer anchors.
TELEM-EXTENS-GIV：Calibration records for the Silverbell Deep Horizon Vault demonstrate a multipoint extensometer accuracy drift of 0.05 mm across borehole rod extensometer anchors.
TELEM-EXTENS-NLI：Calibration records for the Nordic Shield Borehole Complex establish a multipoint extensometer accuracy drift of 0.02 mm across borehole rod extensometer anchors.
